data.gender_notes: Lynna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A diminutive form of the Greek name 'Lynn', derived from 'Lynnos' which means 'lion'. In Christian tradition, the name Lynna is associated with strength, courage, and grace. The name Lynna carries the meaning “Lynn + a” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lynna usually hope their child will grow to embody lynn + a and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lynna total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
